])

    fit = np.linalg.lstsq(A, g[:,2], rcond=None)[0]
    active = np.ones(len(g), dtype=bool)
    for _ in range(4):
        residual = g[:,2] - A @ fit
        median = np.median(residual[active])

def ground_and_boundaries(cid, points):
    b = scene.box(cid)
    p = np.asarray(points.xyz)
    lab = np.asarray(points.semantic_labels)
    pr = np.asarray(points.semantic_probs)
    vehicle = (lab == 9) & (pr[:,9] >= 0.5)
    q = (p - b.center) @ b.rotation
    half = np.asarray(b.size_lwh)/2
    inside = np.all(np.abs(q) <= half, axis=1)
    signed_axes = np.abs(q) - half
    sensor_local = (np.asarray(scene.sensor_origin) - b.center) @ b.rotation
    out = {
        "center": np.asarray(b.center).tolist(),
        "sensor_local": sensor_local.tolist(),
        "truck_n": int(vehicle.sum()),
        "truck_inside_n": int((vehicle & inside).sum()),
        "truck_outside_point_ids": points.point_ids[vehicle & ~inside].tolist(),
        "truck_local_xyz_quantiles_m": (
            np.quantile(q[vehicle],[0.05,0.5,0.95],axis=0).tolist()
            if vehicle.any() else []),
        "truck_outside_each_axis_point_ids": {
            axis: points.point_ids[vehicle & (signed_axes[:,j] > 0.10)].tolist()
            for j,axis in enumerate(["length","width","height"])
        }
    }
    if plane is not None:
        bottom = corners[cid][np.array([False,True]*4) == False]
        clearance = bottom[:,2] - (np.c_[bottom[:,:2]-anchor_xy,np.ones(len(bottom))] @ plane)
        out["bottom_corner_ground_clearance_m"] = clearance.tolist()
    return out

comparison1 = diagnose.compare(
    "Do translations cut credible truck returns or materially cross measured ground?",
    ground_and_boundaries, candidate_ids=cids, point_ids=support.point_ids,
    evidence_sources=["LIDAR_CURRENT","S0","SENSOR_POSE","D0","CANDIDATES"],
    assumptions=[
        "S0 truck labels are class evidence, not instance identity.",
        "Ground plane uses confident ground labels outside all candidate footprints.",
        "Box corners include the retained D0 tilt; no shape correction is allowed.",
        "Current scan and semantics may have been used by candidate generators."
    ]
)
print("COMPARISON", comparison1)
camera1 = viz.preset_camera("complementary", points=support, box_ids=cids, image_size=900)
view1 = viz.render(support, camera1, box_ids=cids, color_mode="semantic",
                   highlight_ids=ground_ids, title="Shared support; highlighted ground-fit returns")
show(view1, "All candidate boxes on the same current scan; highlighted points define the tentative ground fit.")

            np.quantile(qq[side,1]-half[1],[.05,.5,.95]).tolist() if side.any() else [],

        nearest = np.sqrt(((bottom_global[:,None,:2]-gp[None,:,:2])**2).sum(axis=2)).min(axis=1)

    lab = np.asarray(points.semantic_labels)
    pr = np.asarray(points.semantic_probs)

        "ground_height_above_bottom_local_m": (qq[ground_under,2]+half[2]).tolist()
    }
    return result

values.diagnostic_question: Which translations place both measured upper and coherent low truck surfaces within retained-height boundaries?
values.program_source:
def upper_and_lower_faces(cid, points):
    b = scene.box(cid)
    qq = (np.asarray(points.xyz)-b.center) @ b.rotation
    half = np.asarray(b.size_lwh)/2
    roof = np.isin(points.point_ids,roof_ids)
    low = np.isin(points.point_ids,low_ids)
    result = {
        "upper_point_ids": points.point_ids[roof].tolist(),
        "upper_signed_top_face_residual_m": (qq[roof,2]-half[2]).tolist(),
        "upper_horizontal_inside": np.all(np.abs(qq[roof,:2])<=half[:2],axis=1).tolist(),
        "upper_point_ids_above_top_by_over_1cm":
            points.point_ids[roof & (qq[:,2]>half[2]+0.01)].tolist(),
        "low_point_ids": points.point_ids[low].tolist(),
        "low_signed_bottom_face_residual_m": (qq[low,2]+half[2]).tolist(),
        "side_face_residual_q05_q50_q95_m": np.quantile(
            qq[np.isin(points.point_ids,side_ids),1]-half[1],[.05,.5,.95]).tolist()
    }
    return result

V4 confirms those returns lie along the visible truck boundary. E6 also reveals six upper truck returns spanning the footprint with nearly identical D0-local height, about 0.572 m. Testing their planarity and top-face offsets can distinguish genuine vertical miscentering from low-surface bias; upper-surface identity remains a hypothesis until this check and highlighted view are inspected.
agent_interpretation.after_execution: E8 is decisive: the same six planar upper returns lie 2.4–2.5 cm below `TRACK_TO_DET:15`’s top, versus approximately 41 cm for KEEP and 33 cm for `TRACK_TO_DET:14`. It also accommodates four coherent low returns that both higher boxes exclude. E5 finds its lower face remains above nearby measured ground; the earlier extrapolated-plane penetration concern is therefore insufficient. V3–V5 show the inspected points along the truck support. Counterevidence remains: KEEP fits the observed side about 11 cm more closely, and the upper patch is small, not a confirmed complete roof. Nevertheless, the paired upper/lower boundary evidence supports the substantial vertical correction. Semantic agreement, containment counts, and prior provenance alone would not suffice.
